iaiops-pharma v0.32.0

- Removed "skill-card.md" file.
- Expanded SKILL.md with a new tool: `plc_program_xref_config` for detailed PLC program cross-referencing.
- All other existing features retained; documentation updated for clarity and completeness.

iaiops 0.31.0: serial ASCII instruments (15th protocol); MCP tools that read or write a host file are confined to the agent's roots (a write path could replace the audit DB before); sensor follow-ups. See CHANGELOG upgrade notes.
iaiops 0.30.0: sensor layer end to end (profiles, IO-Link collection, switching sensors, units, profile library) and three OPC UA collection fixes. See CHANGELOG upgrade notes.
iaiops 0.29.0: call-origin audit, OEE stop attribution, bearer-token sockets, CRA vulnerability handling, UK half-hourly meter analytics, companion-spec role hints. See CHANGELOG.
0.28.0: MQTT/Sparkplug collectable; onboard's two journeys (devices / uns with a B1/B2 namespace fork)
router now routes to the pharma edition · contextual baselines · downtime attribution (D18) · alarm event-type clustering · device advisory matching · GxP crosswalk
verify determinism (executed model-free claim) · PLC program change baseline · pharma edition
